Oguri Cap garners immense attention as a 
hero rising from the regional circuit.

Facing Oguri Cap in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), Super Creek finds herself cast 
as the villain in the eyes of the public.

Super Creek resolved to fulfill public 
expectations by running the race as the 
villain. On top of that, she declared that 
she would defeat Oguri Cap.
